title: This Room Is Lying to You 👀

segments.say: This room is lying to you.

segments.text: A free AI sees its *real 3D shape* from one photo. No depth camera.
segments.say: A free AI sees its real 3D shape from one single photo. No depth camera.

segments.text: …on a sketch… and wait for *the Moon.*
segments.say: on a simple sketch, and wait for the Moon.

segments.text: How: it's called *Depth Anything V2.* Free online demo.
segments.say: It's called Depth Anything V2. Upload any photo to the free demo, and download its depth map.
I gave it the nineteen sixty nine Moon photo,
and turned its depth map into a 3D shot.
